name: a promise you'd never keep
source:
It's been too long since you've seen the man that now calls himself Cypress—he's now one of the hottest new stars in the hero industry, rising above the nameless crowd of hero hopefuls.

But what his fans don't know is that Cypress hides a secret, one intertwined with the past the both of you share. And unlike his fans, you won't be so quick to forgive.

This time, Cypress can't run from you.

[From [url=https://lemonink.itch.io/a-promise-youd-never-keep]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你已经很久没有见到这个自称Cypress的人了——他现在是英雄行业最炙手可热的新星之一，超越了无名的英雄希望者。

但他的粉丝不知道的是，赛普里斯隐藏着一个秘密，这个秘密与你们共同的过去交织在一起。与他的粉丝不同的是，你不会那么快原谅他。

这一次，赛普拉斯无法再逃避你了。

[来自[url=https://lemonink.itch.io/a-promise-youd-never-keep]itch.io[/url]]
